decision: Preserve this citation trail as a retrieval lead. The direct fish report and its species list were not located; do not convert the secondary richness statement or the uncertain IUCN mention into species or occurrence claims.

undatedFishReport.citationAsPrinted: Pagulayan R., n.d. Fishes in the freshwater streams of Subic Bay Forest Reserve, Zambales.
undatedFishReport.discoverySource: Guzman & Capaque (2014), Inventory of ecologically-important fish species in Bugang River, Philippines, AACL Bioflux 7(5), pp. 396-404; reference list and introduction reviewed.
undatedFishReport.directCopyOrCatalog: Not located in the bounded exact-title, author, UP Diliman, and institutional-repository search. This is not evidence that no copy or catalog record exists.
undatedFishReport.secondaryClaim: The 2014 paper's introduction attributes a statement to Pagulayan (n.d.) that five tributary rivers of the Subic Bay Forest Reserve had 16-40 fish species collected from each site.
limits: No taxon list, exact field dates, sample methods, station-level locality data, vouchers, or item-specific reuse terms were verified from the cited report.
The secondary paper is about Bugang River in Antique; its own fish data do not belong to Central Luzon.
The phrase 'each site' is retained as the secondary source's wording; its mapping to five specific rivers or collection sites was not checked against the original report.

separate2002Report.citationAsPrinted: Pagulayan, R.C. (2002). Ecological status of the aquatic ecosystem of Subic Bay Forest Reserve: Assessment of the major river systems and notes on the estuary and coastal zone biodata. Research report submitted to the Commission on Higher Education (CHED).
separate2002Report.discoverySource: A 2010 Silliman Journal article's bibliography, available through Central Philippine University repository.
separate2002Report.projectExistenceCrossCheck: The official U.P. Gazette records a 29 February 2000 agreement with CHED for a Subic Bay aquatic-ecosystem assessment project. This confirms a related project agreement, not delivery or contents of the cited 2002 report.
separate2002Report.relationshipToUndatedFishReport: Not established. Do not assume this 2002 report is the same item as the undated 'Fishes in the freshwater streams' citation.

relatedHistoricalSources.citation: Pagulayan & Hernandez (1999), 'Subic Bay Forest Rivers: What Mollusks Do They Support?', Transactions of NAST Philippines 21.
relatedHistoricalSources.scope: Mollusk sampling in six major rivers, November 1997-July 1998; not fish evidence.

relatedHistoricalSources.citation: Hernandez & Pagulayan (2002), 'Benthic Insect Fauna of Subic Bay Forest Reserve Streams', Transactions of NAST Philippines 24(1).
relatedHistoricalSources.scope: Benthic insects from five streams sampled in 2001; not fish evidence.

separateTaxonLead.source: IUCN Red List 2018 assessment for Doryichthys deokhatoides (Bleeker, 1854).
separateTaxonLead.reportedText: The assessment labels Philippine presence uncertain and says a Zambales record attributed to Pagulayan (2011) requires confirmation.
separateTaxonLead.relationshipToUndatedFishReport: Unresolved; the IUCN reference to Pagulayan (2011) is not shown to be the undated report cited by Guzman & Capaque (2014).
separateTaxonLead.decision: Do not treat this as a verified Zambales occurrence or current presence record. Identify the cited Pagulayan 2011 source and voucher, if available, before any taxon-level assertion.

retrievalAndReuse.boundedSearch: Exact title and variants, Pagulayan/Subic author searches, and UP Diliman/institutional-repository domain searches were run on 2026-11-24. They found the secondary citation trail and related project records, but no direct fish report copy or reliable catalog record.
retrievalAndReuse.reuseTerms: Unknown for both cited Pagulayan reports. Secondary citation and public project-agreement pages do not grant rights to reuse underlying report contents.
